senses.title: 而且；此外
senses.usageNote: 副词，可引出进一步的信息。

examples.en: The course is useful. Moreover, it is free.
examples.zh: 这门课程很实用，而且免费。

examples.en: She is talented and, moreover, hardworking.

confusions.title: moreover 与 however

example.en: The course is useful. Moreover, it is free.
The course is useful. However, it is costly.

confusions.takeaway: moreover 引出补充信息；however 在此表示转折。
